message.content:
If you mean **free satellite radio**, the main real option is usually a **limited-time free trial** from SiriusXM rather than permanently free service.[1][6] SiriusXM currently advertises a **3-month free trial** with **no credit card required** for eligible new or inactive radios, and some partners also offer trial access.[1][4][6]

A few useful distinctions:

- **In-car satellite radio trials:** Eligible factory-installed radios may get a complimentary trial, often with no credit card required.[2][6]
- **App/streaming trials:** SiriusXM also offers app-only promotional trials, including a **3-month free** plan in some cases.[1][6]
- **Partner promotions:** Some companies, such as **T-Mobile** or **Navy Federal Credit Union**, have their own SiriusXM trial offers for eligible customers.[4][5]
- **Past “free listen” events:** SiriusXM sometimes runs temporary free-listening periods, but those are time-limited and may have ended.[3]

If you want, I can help you find the **best current free SiriusXM offer** for your car, phone, or TV provider.
